🧸 Squishy Tower: 250+ Stages
Theme: Everything is made from soft, squishy toys and foods. Each world has a different squishy style with unique obstacles.🟨 World 1 - Butter Land (Stages 1-50)
Butter stick jumps
Melting butter slides
Butter cube maze
Toast platforms
Pancake stack climb
Butter waterfall
🟢 World 2 - NeeDoh World (Stages 51-100)
Giant NeeDoh balls
Stretchy bridges
Squish launch pads
Bubble tunnels
Color-changing platforms
Bounce rooms
🥟 World 3 - Dumpling Village (Stages 101-150)
Steamed dumplings
Chopstick balance beams
Soy sauce lakes
Bamboo steamers
Giant bao jumps
Noodle swings
🍡 World 4 - Mochi & Candy (Stages 151-200)
Mochi trampolines
Jelly cubes
Marshmallow clouds
Gummy bear parkour
Lollipop spinning poles
Cotton candy climb
🌈 World 5 - Ultimate Squishy Factory (Stages 201-250+)
Squishy-making machines
Conveyor belts
Giant presses (safe timing obstacles)
Rainbow slime rivers
Squishy monster boss escape
Neon rainbow finale
⭐ Bonus Stages (251-300)
Impossible Butter Challenge
Invisible Squishies
Tiny Mode
Giant Mode
Speed Run
Low Gravity
Rainbow Tower
Lava Squish
Ice Squish
Secret Developer Room
🎁 Collectibles
🧈 Butter Pets
🟢 NeeDoh Pets
🥟 Dumpling Pets
🍡 Mochi Pets
🧸 Teddy Squishy
🐸 Frog Squishy
🦄 Unicorn Squishy
🐼 Panda Squishy
🏆 Rewards
Checkpoint every 5 stages
Free trails
Squishy-themed badges
Daily spin wheel
Secret hidden rooms
Rebirth system
VIP area with exclusive squishies
This gives you 300 stages total, with plenty of variety so the tower doesn't feel repetitive. You can also add seasonal updates (Halloween, Christmas, Easter, Summer) with new squishy-themed stages and collectibles to keep players coming back.

answers.ask: 300 stages will not fit one image. Do you want the five worlds built as five separate towers stacked in fiction, or one continuous spiral generated in passes?
answers.answer: Build the five worlds as five separate themed towers, progressing in order from Butter Land through the Ultimate Squishy Factory; this keeps each world distinct and manageable.

answers.ask: Is each world its own tower with a teleporter between them, or does one tower run all the way up?
answers.answer: Each world is its own tower, with a teleporter at the completed tower’s top leading to the next world.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D obby layout of five separate themed towers, progressing in order through teleporters at the completed top of each tower. Butter Land occupies the first 50-stage tower with butter-stick jumps, melting butter slides, a butter-cube maze, toast platforms, pancake-stack climbs, and a butter waterfall. NeeDoh World follows with giant squishy balls, stretchy bridges, launch pads, bubble tunnels, color-changing platforms, and bounce rooms. Dumpling Village uses steamed dumplings, chopstick balance beams, soy-sauce lakes, bamboo steamers, giant bao jumps, and noodle swings. Mochi & Candy includes mochi trampolines, jelly cubes, marshmallow clouds, gummy-bear parkour, lollipop poles, and a cotton-candy climb. The final Ultimate Squishy Factory tower contains squishy-making machines, conveyor belts, giant presses, rainbow slime rivers, an escape route past a squishy monster, and a neon rainbow finale. Include hidden rooms, a VIP area, and a separate bonus-stage area with the Rainbow Tower, Lava Squish, Ice Squish, and a secret developer room.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Obby & Platformer, canonically `obby-platformer`: player-paced jumping and climbing define the game.

## Shape and preset
Use `course-tower` for five separately rendered vertical courses. Tower Obby is the matching preset, extended with inter-tower teleporters, regular checkpoints, and a mid-course maze.

## Config requirements
Draw a physics-valid `path-track` through all 250 main stages; `obstacle-jump` covers food platforms, launch pads, trampoline jumps, and balance beams; `obstacle-moving` covers slides, swings, poles, conveyors, and presses; `obstacle-timing` covers the safe-timing presses and changing platforms; `obstacle-climb` covers pancake stacks and cotton candy; and `obstacle-maze` forms the butter-cube maze. Draw safe pads for `checkpoint-respawn`, visible gateways for `teleporter-link`, the neon finale as `winner-zone`, and enterable hidden, VIP, and developer rooms as `building-interior`.

## Layout requirements
Place `checkpoint-respawn` every five stages, totaling 50 main-course checkpoints, on enclosed landing pads. Place four sequential `teleporter-link` pairs from each completed tower top to the next tower entrance, plus links into the separate bonus area. Place one `winner-zone` at the fifth tower’s neon finale.

## Layout components
Build five distinct 50-stage towers in sequence, each with its named obstacle set and a protected base, ascending critical path, and completed-top portal. Keep soy-sauce lakes, the butter waterfall, and slime rivers contained within their themed towers. The separate bonus area contains Rainbow Tower, Lava Squish, Ice Squish, and the secret developer room. Hidden rooms branch briefly without interrupting the main route; the VIP area sits off the shared arrival space. Frame each tower to show its base-to-summit progression.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: the valid ordered jump chain and portal progression must lead, then the isometric view dresses that plan.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is huge because the build contains five 50-stage towers plus bonus stages. The theme is bright, tactile squishy toys and foods. `P6` guarantees legal course and maze topology, `P2` handles vertically stacked tower surfaces, `P3` handles enterable secret and VIP rooms, and `P4` handles five separate tower maps and the bonus area.
